ui.title: Fortknight
ui.subtitle: Chess Battle Royale
ui.arcade: Arcade <text style='color: red'> (Pieces move based on a timer)</text>
ui.pacifist: Pacifist <text style='color: red'> (No score for kills)</text>
ui.strategist: Strategist <text style='color: red'> (Pieces have move order)</text>
ui.drunk: Drunk pieces <text style='color: red'> (Pieces always move randomly)</text>
ui.loop: Loop Pieces <text style='color: red'> (Pieces on the edge rotate By 90 degrees Anti-Clockwise every move)</text>
ui.yes_i_know: yes, i know the chessboard only has 7 squares, not 8, but i wanted a centre square
ui.click_square: Click on a square to move.
ui.pieces_start: Pieces start small for 3 turns. Small pieces are harmless. Land on pieces to take them, but don't let them land on you!
ui.pawns_move: Pawns move in direction indicated every two turns and can take on forward diagonals in any turn.
ui.pawns_move_other: Pawns move in direction indicated every {{count}} turns and can take on forward diagonals in any turn.
ui.skip_turn: To skip a turn, click your knight.
ui.pieces_move: Pieces will move to take your knight if they can; or randomly otherwise
ui.small_pieces: Small pieces block the movement of other pieces, but big pieces don't. However, you can land on small pieces and if a big piece can't move, it dies.

game.forfeit_status: {{score}} You have forfeited the game!

rules.forfeit: You must <button class='button' onclick='forfeitGame()'>forfeit</button> the game in order to change the game mode
rules.scoring_rule_1: +1 point for every turn on the field
rules.scoring_rule_3: +3 points for every knight, bishop, rook taken
rules.pieces_start_small: Pieces start small for 3 turns. Small pieces are harmless. Land on pieces to take them, but don't let them land on you!

pacifist.scoring_rule_1: Only get points for staying alive

pacifist.scoring_rule_5: +1.25 points for every (big) queen on the board
